name: Quintorius Kand
description: Quintorius Kand, called Quint, is a loxodon Lorehold student and archaeomancer from Arcavios who became a planeswalker and historian chasing the Coin Empire across planes.

bio.text: At Strixhaven he was assigned the spirit of Asterion as mentor, and with him found a cave and the lost city of Zantafar.

bio.text: He returned to Arcavios saying reports of his death were exaggerated, and at the Fields of Strife he found a cache of Blood Age artifacts.

bio.text: He drove off Stella Lee, who was looting the cache.

citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

status.text: As of the latest story Quint is alive, following the Fomori's trail back to Arcavios and guiding younger students at the Fields of Strife.

citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint grows tired of his spirit mentor Asterion, who talks only of scones and trivia.
timeline.quote: Five minutes into his first encounter with Asterion, Quintorius decided that he had heard just about enough from his spirit mentor.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint performs the Rousing, a burst of heatless flame that animates Asterion's statue.
timeline.quote: a bright burst of heatless flame engulfed the statue

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint reads Asterion his genealogy from the school's records.
timeline.quote: Your father was Lord Teutamos of Pallad Reach

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint asks about Asterion's death, noting reports he left toward Pillardrop and was never found.
timeline.quote: A series of reports indicate that you were last seen leaving the school grounds traveling toward Pillardrop.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Asterion asks to see the cave, but Quint says spirit statues cannot leave Effigy Row.
timeline.quote: Spirit statues aren't permitted to leave Effigy Row.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint reveals he helps at the dig where Asterion's statue was found, hoping to prove the school sits on Moragitzu-Kesh.
timeline.quote: it's the cave where they found your statue buried under an ancient rockslide

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Asterion recites the Canticle of Jed and says the lost city is Zantafar, which he sought long ago.
timeline.quote: I know enough not to mistake Zantafar for Moragitzu-Kesh.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Asterion urges Quint to find the lost city of Zantafar as his responsibility.
timeline.quote: There's a lost city to discover.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint and the unauthorized Asterion sneak past the dig camp at Pillardrop.
timeline.quote: Quint spotted Professor Hofri Ghostforge, the project lead, warming himself by the fire

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint recalls using magic to defeat three hazing cadets, which got him expelled from Rundlestrom (flashback).
timeline.quote: It was a fairly simple matter to reach out and drop a wall banner on the head of one attacker

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint stumbles and is caught by Professor Ghostforge, while Asterion hides.
timeline.quote: Why are you not back at campus?

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Hofri tells Quint about his own unhappy mentor Siulogma and offers to talk any time.
timeline.quote: You know you can talk to me any time.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Asterion leads Quint into a cave and recognizes a stone column.
timeline.quote: I remember this formation distinctly.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint's magical map shows others have explored the cave before.
timeline.quote: A single point of golden energy flared upward from the page.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint, angry at the empty cave, shouts at Asterion, who reveals he overheard him call him a disappointment.
timeline.quote: In life, I was partially deaf in the left ear.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint recites the Canticle of Jed and the stone column retracts to reveal a dark shaft.
timeline.quote: A low rumble shook the cave, and with a grinding sound, the column retracted into the ground, leaving a hole that led to pitch-black darkness.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Asterion warns Quint that he did not return from here and describes the afterlife as a place of forgetting.
timeline.quote: Do you know what it's like to be dead?

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint ropes down into the shaft.
timeline.quote: With a push of his legs, Quint lowered himself into the darkness.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint finds an enormous golden statue of a loxodon in a chamber.
timeline.quote: an enormous golden statue of a loxodon in repose

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: They find Asterion's mummified body below, broken by a fall.
timeline.quote: Quint approached and saw a human body, or what was left of one after six hundred years.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Asterion admits he fell to his death and thought his life meaningless.
timeline.quote: I didn't think it would be so far down.

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint shows Asterion the lost city of Zantafar spread beneath them.
timeline.quote: a sprawling ghost metropolis rose from the stone, lit in an eternal twilight by luminescent fungi above

citation.work: The Mentor
citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint summons Asterion for a fourth session, and Asterion asks to leave Effigy Row.
timeline.quote: Asterion, however, expressed a desire to leave Effigy Row and explore the campus

citation.work: Asterion
citation.text: "Asterion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Asterion insists on visiting the cave at Pillardrop despite the rules.
timeline.quote: Asterion insisted on visiting this cave

citation.work: Asterion
citation.text: "Asterion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint sneaks Asterion past researchers, avoiding Professor Ghostforge.
timeline.quote: They snuck past a group of researchers and professors at the dig site

citation.work: Asterion
citation.text: "Asterion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Asterion reveals he sought Zantafar, and Quint follows him into the cave.
timeline.quote: Asterion shared that he was searching for the lost city of Zantafar

citation.work: Asterion
citation.text: "Asterion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the cave Asterion tells of his friend Vis's unjust execution.
timeline.quote: a loxodon unjustly executed

citation.work: Asterion
citation.text: "Asterion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint recites the Canticle of Jed, opening a passage to Zantafar.
timeline.quote: This recitation triggered a hidden mechanism

citation.work: Asterion
citation.text: "Asterion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They find Asterion's mummified body and stand before Zantafar.
timeline.quote: they found Asterion’s own mummified body

citation.work: Asterion
citation.text: "Asterion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint is expelled from Rundlestrom Military Academy for clumsiness and then joins Strixhaven University.
timeline.quote: Quint joined Strixhaven University

citation.work: Quintorius
citation.text: "Quintorius", section "At Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With his spirit mentor Asterion's help Quint rediscovers the lost Loxodon city of Zantafar.
timeline.quote: Quint rediscovered the lost Loxodon city of Zantafar

citation.work: Quintorius
citation.text: "Quintorius", section "At Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint gives Killian a book about the Mute Quillancer who used sign language.
timeline.quote: Dobarius Egolt, the Mute Quillancer

citation.work: A Silent Voice Calls
citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Quintorius has ignited as a planeswalker during the Invocation.
timeline.quote: Liliana quickly deduced that he had actually ignited as a Planeswalker.

citation.work: Liliana Vess
citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When the Phyrexians invade, Vess sends the surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.work: Dina
citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The compleated Nassari distracts Rootha, so Quint compensates with raw magic and lifeforce; his spark ignites and he planeswalks away, though the Invocation repels the main wave.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

citation.work: Dina
citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
timeline.quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint summons the spirit of Dean Herrian the Second from a statue, who reveals they are directly under the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: How can you be lost when you're under the Biblioplex?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
timeline.quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A dwarf student calls for help and is dragged away by a compleated figure, and Quint's cry draws Dean Shaile's attention.
timeline.quote: Dean Shaile's head abruptly swiveled around.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
timeline.quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dean Shaile seizes Killian, demanding the whereabouts of his father.
timeline.quote: Where is your father?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Embrose flings the students out of the fight so they can find the invocation, and Killian sends him supportive words.
timeline.quote: And without warning lashes of black whipped around the students' torsos

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
timeline.quote: No talking in the library!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
timeline.quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
timeline.quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint grabs Rootha's petal and pours his life into the invocation to complete it.
timeline.quote: he powered the invocation with his life alone

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A light erupts from Quint, wrecking the Biblioplex and Dean Nassari, closing the portals and swallowing Quint.
timeline.quote: Dean Nassari was flung from the rooftop

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina reports that Quint vanished in a burst of light, and Liliana wonders if he sparked.
timeline.quote: If Quint's spark ignited, he could still be alive

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Invocation is activated; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away, but the attackers are repelled.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.work: Killian Lu
citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quintorius Kand vanishes as his spark ignites from casting the Invocation.
timeline.quote: Quintorius Kand had vanished, his planeswalker's spark ignited by the stress of casting the Invocation

citation.work: New Phyrexian Invasion
citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Invasion, Quint tries to cover for Rootha at the Invocation of the Founders with raw magic, his spark ignites, and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

citation.work: Quintorius
citation.text: "Quintorius", section "New Phyrexian Invasion of Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint explores the Multiverse, and Lorehold believes him dead for months, while he finds a coin motif he calls the Coin Empire.
timeline.quote: he discovered a mysterious coin motif prevalent across many planes

citation.work: Quintorius
citation.text: "Quintorius", section "Through the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends surviving students to find the Invocation.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.work: Rootha Squallheart
citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nassari distracts Rootha, Quint covers her part with raw magic, his spark ignites and he planeswalks away; Rootha is wounded.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.work: Rootha Squallheart
citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Vess sends surviving students to activate the Invocation of the Founders; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: in the process, Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.work: Zimone Wola
citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli lies about summoning help from Strixhaven and Ghirapur but enlists Quintorius Kand for an expedition below Orazca.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had lied about contacting her home plane

citation.work: Saheeli Rai
citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint planeswalks to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: As Quint planeswalked from a dimly lit stone corridor into leaf-dappled sunshine, the heat slapped him like a moist towel.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Three dinosaurs corner Quint in the jungle.
timeline.quote: He looked up and found himself dangerously close to an open mouth full of curved pointy teeth.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta calls off the dinosaurs, rescuing Quint, and introduces herself.
timeline.quote: With the flick of a hand, she dismissed the others as if they were trained pets, and they disappeared into the jungle.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta leads Quint to a view of the golden city of Orazca.
timeline.quote: saw the full, blinding brilliance of the golden city in the valley below

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint meets Saheeli and Huatli in a chamber of tablets and a huge golden door.
timeline.quote: This is my partner, Huatli.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli explains that the translated glyphs suggest the door leads to the birthplace of humanity and home of the gods.
timeline.quote: I believe they're the key to opening this.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Inti arrives and is introduced as Huatli's cousin and a hero of the war against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Seneschal of the sun, dinosaur rider, hero of the war against the Phyrexians.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli finishes translating the tablets' poem about the Komon and the imprisoned god Chimil.
timeline.quote: The translation was finished.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli realizes the door's glyphs match the tablets symbolically and slots them in correctly; the golden door cracks open.
timeline.quote: A whisper of magic touched her fingers, and the space around each tablet glowed softly.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Beyond the door, Huatli's party finds glowing, linen-wrapped warrior corpses and the armored remains of a massive horned creature.
timeline.quote: The remains of a massive humanoid creature dominated the opposite corner of the room

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint tastes a fragment from a pile of broken pottery and identifies it as bone.
timeline.quote: He picked something up with his trunk and touched it to his tongue.
